description:
College senior Seo Jeong-ha decides it’s finally time to list the speaker her ex-boyfriend gave her on a secondhand marketplace app.

Her reason is simple. She’s recently started seeing Park Min-jun, a handsome, incredibly sweet guy with major boyfriend potential, and keeping her ex’s baggage around is nothing but a massive headache.

Feeling lighter than ever, Jeong-ha heads out to meet the buyer, only to find the absolute last person she ever expected waiting for her…

Her ex-boyfriend, Choi Seo-hoon.

How much do you think this thing costs?! And you’re selling it for a measly hundred and fifty bucks?!

A chaotic love triangle romance sparked by a secondhand deal gone completely wrong!
